mentions.name: Nomen
mentions.description: A memory-safe, ownership-based, auto-freeing programming language that is starting to be used here and there, though it still has a few holes to plug. Started by a human but now mostly implemented by robots.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've built a memory-safe, ownership-based, auto-freeing programming language (https://github.com/andrewjk/nomen) and am starting to use it here and there. It still has a few holes to plug!
